periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis is vertically oriented with a slight outward tilt relative to the vertical midline of the face.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: The eye patch blobs are elongated ovals, with a vertical height significantly greater than the horizontal width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a pronounced downward tapering effect where the patch narrows toward its lowest point, well below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is thick at the lateral flanks, covering approximately one-third of the visible torso height.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: The ears are separated by a wide gap across the crown, roughly equivalent to the width of the forehead.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: The top boundaries of the ears are smoothly rounded and semicircular.

other_distinctive_markers: A thin, vertical stalk is held near the muzzle; a white cross-shaped pattern is visible on the mid-ventral fur; there is significant brownish-yellow discoloration on the lower abdominal and leg fur.
